feature: Health Watch restart CONNECTING and idle HTTP/2 capacity recovery

reference.contract: OnRetryTimerStartLocked reports TRANSIENT_FAILURE; OnCallStartLocked reports CONNECTING; SERVING reports READY

behavior.observer: nextWithDeadlineObserved borrows a synchronous AttemptObserver for one poll; successful fresh Watch establishment notifies before reading the first status; retry sleeps, active Watch reads, expired polls and disabled Watch polls do not notify
behavior.admission: a fresh Watch returns the ordinary endpoint to UNKNOWN/CONNECTING; unary, streaming and duplex starts wait for status or their own deadline/cancellation instead of retaining the preceding TRANSIENT_FAILURE
behavior.capacity: when no Watch exists and peer stream capacity is zero, the same owner pumps HTTP/2 input under the original deadline until SETTINGS restores capacity, without creating a stream or sending a PING probe
behavior.http2_api: pumpClientWithTimeout/Deadline permits one client owner to route input while no handle exists; the original duplex-only pump still requires a registered handle; active-frame routing and HPACK ordering use the shared owner implementation

regressions: after UNAVAILABLE, a peer holds the restarted Watch status while all three fail-fast starts reach their own deadlines; SERVING then completes a default-mode unary call
the observer records four successful fresh attempts while expired/backoff polls, repeated status reads and terminal disabled polls preserve its count
idle HTTP/2 pump consumes zero/restored SETTINGS, starts no stream before capacity returns, rejects expired operations without consuming queued input, and resumes after read timeout
existing multiplexed/duplex pumps retain HPACK ordering, sibling routing, cancellation, partial-frame input and GOAWAY behavior

independent Node peer holds zero capacity until fail-fast rejection is confirmed, restores capacity, holds SERVING until pending-start deadline checks finish, and verifies two reused business calls and disabled-Watch connection EOF with zero PINGs

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='health gate' -Dtest-filter='reconnecting health Watch' -Dtest-filter='HTTP2 idle client pump' -Dtest-filter='HTTP2 client duplex' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='HTTP/2 duplex pump' -Dtest-filter='HTTP/2 multiplexed duplex' -Dtest-filter='gRPC duplex event pump' --summary all
remaining_scope: Broader gRPC composite/xDS integration and long-duration/high-concurrency evidence remain open for the full protocol-library goal.
